roles.name: --page-edge
roles.purpose: the page's edge, narrower on a phone than from a tablet up
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --size-footer-mark
roles.purpose: an image link in a signed-out page's footer, at the smallest size such a mark may be shown
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --surface
roles.purpose: the canvas band behind cards — never a hover fill inside a card

roles.name: edge-page
roles.purpose: A signed-out page's sides: the page edge in from each side, and clear of a phone's notch and rounded corners.
